blocks.zh: Key Message / 核心訊息
blocks.en: Key Message

blocks.zh:
Pure steam quality directly affects sterilization cycle efficacy — Non-condensable gases (NCG) are the most common cause of failed steam penetration tests.
純蒸汽品質直接影響滅菌循環效能——不可凝氣體（NCG）是蒸汽穿透測試失敗最常見的原因。
blocks.en:
Pure steam quality directly affects the efficacy of the sterilization cycle.
Non-condensable gases (NCG) are the most common cause of failed steam penetration tests.

blocks.zh: Types, uses, and regulatory basis for pure steam | 種類、用途與純蒸汽的法規基礎
blocks.en: Types, uses, and regulatory basis for pure steam

blocks.zh: 中文解說與應用 — 第 3.1 節
blocks.en: Commentary and Application — Section 3.1

blocks.zh: 監管意涵：什麼時候「必須」用 PSG？
blocks.en: Regulatory implications: when must a PSG be used?

blocks.zh: 判斷原則很直觀：只要蒸汽或其冷凝水直接接觸產品、容器、API、滅菌負載，就必須使用 Pure Steam Generator（PSG）。這是法規的底線，不能以「化學品已移除」作為替代論述。
blocks.en: The rule of thumb is simple: whenever the steam or its condensate comes into direct contact with product, containers, API or the load being sterilized, a Pure Steam Generator (PSG) must be used. This is the regulatory floor, and "the chemicals have been removed" is not an acceptable substitute argument.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務補充：外包製造商在接受新客戶產品時，應第一時間確認高壓滅菌器的純蒸汽供應來源。若客戶要求符合 EP 標準出口到歐洲，則 BS EN 285 合規就是強制要求。
blocks.en: CDMO practice note: when taking on a new client's product, a contract manufacturer should confirm the source of pure steam supplied to the autoclaves at the very start. If the client requires EP compliance for export to Europe, BS EN 285 compliance becomes mandatory.

blocks.zh: 比喻：純蒸汽就像「注射用水的氣態版」
blocks.en: Analogy: pure steam is the "gaseous version of water for injection"

blocks.zh: 想像蒸汽遇到滅菌物品的表面後凝結成水。這滴水如果流入瓶子或接觸產品，其品質等同於注射用水（WFI）。所以純蒸汽的標準，本質上就是「把 WFI 的品質要求延伸到氣態相」。
blocks.en: Picture steam condensing into water when it reaches the surface of the item being sterilized. If that water drips into a vial or touches the product, its quality is equivalent to water for injection (WFI). So the pure steam standard is, in essence, "extending the WFI quality requirement to the gas phase."

blocks.zh: CDMO 高壓滅菌器確認的實際含義
blocks.en: What this means for CDMO autoclave qualification

blocks.zh: 在 aseptic fill-finish CDMO 環境中，所有用於滅菌容器、設備、過濾器的高壓滅菌器都使用純蒸汽。確認（qualification）時，必須證明進入滅菌腔的蒸汽符合：
blocks.en: In an aseptic fill-finish CDMO, all autoclaves used to sterilize containers, equipment and filters use pure steam. During qualification you must demonstrate that the steam entering the chamber meets:

blocks.zh: 冷凝水化學品質（WFI 標準）
blocks.en: Condensate chemical quality (WFI standard)

blocks.zh: BS EN 285 物理參數（NCG、乾燥度、過熱度）
blocks.en: BS EN 285 physical parameters (NCG, dryness, superheat)

blocks.zh: 這也是為什麼純蒸汽取樣不能只在「水系統」章節處理，而需要獨立的取樣計畫。
blocks.en: This is also why pure steam sampling cannot simply be handled in the water system chapter and needs its own sampling plan.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3.1
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 3.1

blocks.zh: 你的工廠使用高壓滅菌器對最終藥品包裝進行終端滅菌（terminal sterilization）。您的純蒸汽系統目前使用廠用蒸汽（Plant Steam）通過熱交換器間接加熱水，再轉換為蒸汽。這樣的設計符合 ISPE 的要求嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your site uses an autoclave for terminal sterilization of final drug product packaging. Your pure steam system currently uses plant steam to heat water indirectly through a heat exchanger, converting it to steam. Does this design meet ISPE expectations? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: 客戶要求您提供「Chemical-free steam」用於非關鍵 API 製程。您如何確認這個要求是否恰當，以及如何記錄您的決策依據？
blocks.en: A client asks you to supply "chemical-free steam" for a non-critical API process. How do you confirm whether this request is appropriate, and how do you document the rationale for your decision?

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽冷凝水需符合 WFI 規格，請列出 USP WFI 的三個主要品質屬性及其限值。
blocks.en: Pure steam condensate must meet WFI specifications. List three key quality attributes of USP WFI and their limits.

blocks.en: Generation and Distribution of Pharmaceutical Steam

blocks.zh: 3.2.1 Regulatory Requirements / 法規要求
blocks.en: 3.2.1 Regulatory Requirements

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 法規要求
blocks.en: Commentary — Regulatory Requirements

blocks.zh: 兩個互補的法規框架
blocks.en: Two complementary regulatory frameworks

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽需同時符合兩個層次的要求：
blocks.en: Pure steam must satisfy requirements at two levels at the same time:

blocks.zh: USP <1231> / EP 純蒸汽專論：管控冷凝水化學品質——這是「水質」面，以 WFI 為標準
blocks.en: USP <1231> / EP pure steam monograph: controls condensate chemical quality — the "water quality" side, with WFI as the benchmark

blocks.zh: BS EN 285:2015：管控蒸汽物理品質——這是「蒸汽狀態」面，包含 NCG、乾燥度、過熱度
blocks.en: BS EN 285:2015: controls physical steam quality — the "steam state" side, covering NCG, dryness and superheat

blocks.zh: 兩者相輔相成，缺一不可。化學面合格但物理面不合格，同樣無法保證滅菌效果。
blocks.en: The two complement each other and neither can be dropped. Passing on chemistry but failing on physical quality still cannot assure sterilization efficacy.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Nitrogen Blanket 會造成 NCG 超標？
blocks.en: Why can a nitrogen blanket push NCG out of specification?

blocks.zh: 氮氣覆蓋（nitrogen blanket）用於防止 WFI/PW 儲存槽中的微生物生長，但氮氣會溶解在水中。當這些水進入純蒸汽產生器加熱時，溶解的氮氣會釋放，成為蒸汽中的不可凝氣體（NCG）。
blocks.en: A nitrogen blanket is used to prevent microbial growth in WFI/PW storage tanks, but nitrogen dissolves in the water. When that water is heated in the pure steam generator, the dissolved nitrogen is released and becomes non-condensable gas (NCG) in the steam.

blocks.zh: 實務啟示：若以氮氣覆蓋的 WFI 作為 PSG 進水，應增加除氣裝置（degassifier / deaerator），否則 NCG 很可能超過 BS EN 285 的 3.5% 限值。
blocks.en: Practical takeaway: if nitrogen-blanketed WFI is used as PSG feed water, a degassifier / deaerator should be added; otherwise NCG is likely to exceed the 3.5% limit in BS EN 285.

blocks.zh: 比喻：除氣就像煮沸礦泉水
blocks.en: Analogy: degassing is like boiling mineral water

blocks.zh: 礦泉水瓶打開時有氣泡（溶解的 CO₂）。加熱到沸點時，氣體逸出。純蒸汽產生器的除氣裝置原理相同——在進入鍋爐前先把水加熱，讓溶解的氣體「提前」逸出，避免它們隨蒸汽進入滅菌腔造成冷點。
blocks.en: When you open a bottle of sparkling mineral water, bubbles appear (dissolved CO₂). Heat it to boiling and the gas escapes. The degassing unit on a pure steam generator works on the same principle: the water is heated before it enters the boiler so that dissolved gases escape "early" instead of travelling with the steam into the sterilizer chamber and creating cold spots.

blocks.zh: 進口歐洲產品的 CDMO 注意事項
blocks.en: Points for CDMOs serving the European market

blocks.zh: 若您的 CDMO 承接歐洲市場的 sterile drug product 製造，確認報告必須明確陳述純蒸汽符合 BS EN 285。這不僅是技術要求，也是查廠（inspection）時查核員的常見查核點。建議在確認計畫（Qualification Plan）中加入明確章節，對應 BS EN 285 的各項條款。
blocks.en: If your CDMO manufactures sterile drug product for the European market, the qualification report must state explicitly that the pure steam complies with BS EN 285. This is not only a technical requirement but also a common inspection focus. We recommend adding a dedicated section to the Qualification Plan that maps to each applicable clause of BS EN 285.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3.2.1
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 3.2.1

blocks.zh: USP <645> 導電度測試有三個階段，請說明 Stage 1、2、3 的差異，以及在什麼情況下需要進入 Stage 3 pH 測試？
blocks.en: The USP <645> conductivity test has three stages. Explain the differences between Stage 1, 2 and 3, and under what circumstances you must proceed to the Stage 3 pH test.

blocks.zh: BS EN 285 對進水的氯化物限值（≤2 mg/l）遠比冷凝水的限值（≤0.1 mg/l）寬鬆。為什麼要分別設定進水和冷凝水的規格？
blocks.en: The BS EN 285 chloride limit for feed water (≤2 mg/l) is much more relaxed than the limit for condensate (≤0.1 mg/l). Why are separate specifications set for feed water and condensate?

blocks.zh: 您的 PSG 使用氮氣覆蓋的 WFI 作為進水，但沒有安裝 degassifier。請評估這個設計的風險，並提出改善方案。
blocks.en: Your PSG uses nitrogen-blanketed WFI as feed water but has no degassifier installed. Assess the risk of this design and propose improvements.

blocks.zh: 3.2.2 Consensus Standards / 共識標準
blocks.en: 3.2.2 Consensus Standards

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 共識標準網絡
blocks.en: Commentary — The Network of Consensus Standards

blocks.zh: 標準層次架構
blocks.en: Hierarchy of standards

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽領域有一個相互引用的標準網絡：
blocks.en: In the pure steam field there is a network of standards that refer to one another:

blocks.zh: ISPE GPG（本指南）：取樣策略和計畫設計
blocks.en: ISPE GPG (this guide): sampling strategy and sampling plan design

blocks.zh: BS EN 285：大型蒸汽滅菌器的設計與測試，包含蒸汽品質的具體數值規格（最常被引用）
blocks.en: BS EN 285: design and testing of large steam sterilizers, including the specific numerical steam quality specifications (the most frequently cited)

blocks.zh: PDA TR1：濕熱滅菌製程驗證的工業黃金標準
blocks.en: PDA TR1: the industry gold standard for validation of moist heat sterilization processes

blocks.zh: ISO 17665：醫療器材濕熱滅菌的國際標準
blocks.en: ISO 17665: the international standard for moist heat sterilization of medical devices

blocks.zh: ASME BPE：純蒸汽分配系統的工程設計規範
blocks.en: ASME BPE: engineering design standard for pure steam distribution systems

blocks.zh: Bowie & Dick 測試與 NCG 的關聯
blocks.en: The link between the Bowie & Dick test and NCG

blocks.zh: ISO 11140-4 提到的 Bowie & Dick 測試，其核心目的正是偵測蒸汽穿透問題。如果測試失敗，最常見的原因之一就是 NCG 造成的「空氣包覆」（air pocketing）。了解這個標準，有助於理解為什麼 NCG 管控如此重要。
blocks.en: The core purpose of the Bowie & Dick test referred to in ISO 11140-4 is precisely to detect steam penetration problems. When the test fails, one of the most common causes is "air pocketing" caused by NCG. Understanding this standard helps explain why NCG control is so important.

blocks.zh: 在確認文件中引用標準的最佳實務
blocks.en: Best practice for citing standards in qualification documents

blocks.zh: CDMO 的高壓滅菌器確認計畫（qualification plan）應在「References」章節中明確列出所有適用標準，並在每個測試方法旁標注依據哪個標準的哪個章節。例如：
blocks.en: A CDMO's autoclave qualification plan should list all applicable standards explicitly in the "References" section and, next to each test method, note which clause of which standard it is based on. For example:

blocks.zh: NCG 測試 → BS EN 285:2015, Chapter 22.1
blocks.en: NCG test → BS EN 285:2015, Chapter 22.1

blocks.zh: 乾燥度測試 → BS EN 285:2015, Chapter 22.2
blocks.en: Dryness test → BS EN 285:2015, Chapter 22.2

blocks.zh: 過熱度測試 → BS EN 285:2015, Chapter 22.3
blocks.en: Superheat test → BS EN 285:2015, Chapter 22.3

blocks.zh: 這樣的交叉引用能夠大幅提升文件的可追溯性，也便於 FDA/EMA 查廠時的審查。
blocks.en: This kind of cross-referencing greatly improves document traceability and also makes review easier during FDA/EMA inspections.

blocks.zh: 3.2.3 Distribution Systems / 分配系統
blocks.en: 3.2.3 Distribution Systems

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 分配系統設計
blocks.en: Commentary — Distribution System Design

blocks.zh: 316L vs 304L：為什麼純蒸汽要用 316L？
blocks.en: 316L vs 304L: why use 316L for pure steam?

blocks.zh: 高溫蒸汽環境中，316L 的鉬（Mo）含量提供更強的耐點蝕（pitting corrosion）性能，特別是在含有少量氯化物的環境中。304L 雖在常溫水系統中被廣泛使用，但在純蒸汽的高溫循環條件下，長期使用可能出現侵蝕性腐蝕（crevice corrosion）。
blocks.en: In a high-temperature steam environment, the molybdenum (Mo) content of 316L gives better resistance to pitting corrosion, especially where trace chlorides are present. 304L is widely used in ambient-temperature water systems, but under the high-temperature cycling conditions of pure steam, long-term use may lead to crevice corrosion.

blocks.zh: 冷凝水積聚（Condensate Pooling）的系統設計風險
blocks.en: System design risks of condensate pooling

blocks.zh: 蒸汽管路坡度設計不當是純蒸汽系統最常見的設計缺陷之一。積聚的冷凝水會：
blocks.en: Improper slope design of steam lines is one of the most common design defects in pure steam systems. Pooled condensate can:

blocks.zh: 降低進入滅菌腔的蒸汽乾燥度（dryness 下降）
blocks.en: Reduce the dryness of the steam entering the chamber (dryness falls)

blocks.zh: 可能形成「水錘」（water hammer）造成管路損壞
blocks.en: Cause "water hammer" that damages piping

blocks.zh: 在系統低點形成微生物滋生風險
blocks.en: Create a risk of microbial growth at low points in the system

blocks.zh: ASME BPE 規定的 10-20 mm/m 坡度是最低要求，設計時應優先取較大坡度值。
blocks.en: The 10-20 mm/m slope specified by ASME BPE is a minimum requirement; at the design stage the larger slope value should be preferred.

blocks.zh: 比喻：蒸汽管路就像排水溝
blocks.en: Analogy: steam piping is like a drainage ditch

blocks.zh: 想像一條排水溝如果沒有坡度，水就無法流走，反而會積留。純蒸汽管路的道理相同——必須向蒸汽流動方向傾斜，讓冷凝水持續排向蒸汽疏水閥，而不是在管路中積留。「逆坡」（與蒸汽流動方向相反的坡度）等於讓冷凝水流回蒸汽流，是設計上的嚴重錯誤。
blocks.en: Imagine a drainage ditch with no slope: the water cannot flow away and just stands there. Pure steam piping works the same way — it must slope in the direction of steam flow so that condensate keeps draining to the steam trap rather than pooling in the pipe. A "reverse slope" (a slope against the direction of steam flow) lets condensate run back into the steam stream and is a serious design error.

blocks.zh: Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) 的管路設計查核
blocks.en: Piping design checks at the Factory Acceptance Test (FAT)

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 接受純蒸汽系統時，工廠驗收測試（FAT）應包含管路坡度的物理確認（以水平儀測量）。特別要注意：
blocks.en: When a CDMO accepts a pure steam system, the Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) should include physical confirmation of piping slope (measured with a level). Pay particular attention to:

blocks.zh: 熱膨脹後的實際坡度（管路在操作溫度下的形變）
blocks.en: The actual slope after thermal expansion (deformation of the piping at operating temperature)

blocks.zh: 支架（support/hanger）位置是否符合設計坡度
blocks.en: Whether support/hanger locations match the design slope

blocks.zh: 最長的水平管段是否有足夠疏水點
blocks.en: Whether the longest horizontal runs have enough drain points

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3.2.3
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 3.2.3

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽分配管路的表面粗糙度要求（Ra 35-20）比純水系統（通常 Ra 15-20）寬鬆。請從微生物控制的角度解釋為什麼蒸汽系統可以接受較粗的表面。
blocks.en: The surface roughness requirement for pure steam distribution piping (Ra 35-20) is more relaxed than for purified water systems (typically Ra 15-20). From a microbial control perspective, explain why a steam system can accept a rougher surface.

blocks.zh: 設計一個 50 米長的純蒸汽主管路，如果採用最小坡度（10 mm/m），兩端的高度差是多少？這在施工上有什麼限制？
blocks.en: You are designing a 50 m pure steam main. If the minimum slope (10 mm/m) is used, what is the height difference between the two ends? What constraints does this create during construction?

blocks.zh: 為什麼電解拋光（electropolishing）在純蒸汽系統中「可能不必要」甚至可能帶來問題？（提示：rouge formation）
blocks.en: Why might electropolishing be "unnecessary" in a pure steam system, or even cause problems? (Hint: rouge formation)

blocks.zh: Sampling Locations / 取樣位置
blocks.en: Sampling Locations

blocks.zh: CQA-driven location selection: NCG, dryness, superheat, chemical/biological attributes | 以 CQA 驅動位置選擇
blocks.en: CQA-driven location selection: NCG, dryness, superheat, chemical/biological attributes

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 取樣位置選擇原則
blocks.en: Commentary — Principles for Selecting Sampling Locations

blocks.zh: CQA 驅動取樣位置的邏輯
blocks.en: The logic of CQA-driven sampling locations

blocks.zh: 不同的品質屬性需要不同的取樣設備和位置。這是純蒸汽系統取樣設計的核心原則——先定義 CQA，再根據各 CQA 的特性決定在哪裡取樣、如何取樣。
blocks.en: Different quality attributes need different sampling equipment and locations. This is the core principle of sampling design for pure steam systems: define the CQAs first, then decide where and how to sample based on the characteristics of each CQA.

blocks.zh: 3.3.1 Critical Quality Attributes Define Sampling Locations / CQA 定義取樣位置
blocks.en: 3.3.1 Critical Quality Attributes Define Sampling Locations

blocks.zh: 蒸汽品質參數總覽 — 規格、測試方法與重要性
blocks.en: Overview of steam quality parameters — specifications, test methods and significance

blocks.zh: 中文深度解說 — NCG、乾燥度與過熱度
blocks.en: In-Depth Commentary — NCG, Dryness and Superheat

blocks.zh: NCG：最常被忽視的失敗原因
blocks.en: NCG: the most overlooked cause of failure

blocks.zh: 在高壓滅菌器驗證（autoclave validation）中，蒸汽穿透測試（steam penetration test）失敗時，操作人員往往第一反應是檢查溫度探針校準或生物指示劑。但根據現場實務經驗，NCG 超標才是最常見的根本原因，特別是在系統剛完成維護或進水系統切換後。
blocks.en: When a steam penetration test fails during autoclave validation, operators' first reaction is often to check the temperature probe calibration or the biological indicators. In field practice, however, excessive NCG is the most common root cause, especially right after system maintenance or a change of feed water system.

blocks.zh: NCG 的作用原理：不可凝氣體（主要是空氣、氮氣、CO₂）會在滅菌腔中形成氣體夾層（insulating air pocket），阻止蒸汽凝結在負載表面，導致局部溫度達不到滅菌溫度（121°C 或 134°C）。
blocks.en: How NCG works: non-condensable gases (mainly air, nitrogen and CO₂) form an insulating air pocket in the chamber that prevents steam from condensing on the load surface, so local temperatures never reach the sterilization temperature (121°C or 134°C).

blocks.zh: 比喻：NCG 就像保溫瓶裡的空氣
blocks.en: Analogy: NCG is like the air in a thermos

blocks.zh: 想像用蒸汽加熱一個密封容器。如果容器裡預先充滿空氣，蒸汽進入後會與空氣混合，形成「蒸汽-空氣混合物」。這種混合物的飽和溫度低於純蒸汽，意味著在相同壓力下，溫度較低——無法達到滅菌效果。這就是「冷點」（cold spot）的形成機制。
blocks.en: Imagine heating a sealed container with steam. If the container is pre-filled with air, the steam mixes with the air to form a "steam-air mixture." The saturation temperature of this mixture is lower than that of pure steam, meaning that at the same pressure the temperature is lower and sterilization cannot be achieved. This is how a "cold spot" forms.

blocks.zh: 乾燥度 0.95 的物理意義
blocks.en: What a dryness value of 0.95 means physically

blocks.zh: 乾燥度 D = 0.95 代表蒸汽中有 95% 是蒸汽（氣態），5% 是懸浮水滴（液態）。對於金屬負載，這個比例已經足夠——少量水分不會顯著影響蒸汽的熱傳遞能力。
blocks.en: A dryness value of D = 0.95 means that 95% of the steam is vapor (gas phase) and 5% is suspended water droplets (liquid phase). For metal loads this ratio is sufficient — a small amount of moisture does not significantly affect the heat transfer capability of the steam.

blocks.zh: 但乾燥度 < 0.90 時，過多的液態水滴會：
blocks.en: But when dryness is < 0.90, too many liquid droplets will:

blocks.zh: 在負載表面形成水膜，阻礙蒸汽穿透
blocks.en: Form a water film on the load surface that hinders steam penetration

blocks.zh: 稀釋滅菌腔的飽和蒸汽濃度
blocks.en: Dilute the saturated steam concentration in the chamber

blocks.zh: 導致滅菌後負載仍然潮濕，影響包裝完整性
blocks.en: Leave the load still wet after sterilization, affecting packaging integrity

blocks.zh: 取樣方法的侷限性：中心線取樣的誤差
blocks.en: Limitations of the sampling method: error from centerline sampling

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出，從管路中心取樣的乾燥度值不包含管壁水膜和底部冷凝水，因此是近似值而非精確值。儘管如此，這個方法已成為業界標準做法。
blocks.en: ISPE states explicitly that dryness values sampled from the center of the pipe do not include the wall film and the condensate at the bottom of the pipe, so they are approximations rather than exact values. Even so, this method has become standard industry practice.

blocks.zh: 重要啟示：在解讀測試結果時，應了解測試方法的局限，並在確認報告中明確說明取樣方法依據 BS EN 285:2015 Ch. 22.2，以保持與「已建立的接受值」的連結（linkage）。
blocks.en: Key point: when interpreting test results, understand the limits of the test method, and state clearly in the qualification report that the sampling method follows BS EN 285:2015 Ch. 22.2, so as to maintain the linkage to the "established acceptance values."

blocks.zh: CDMO 高壓滅菌器確認中的蒸汽品質測試策略
blocks.en: Steam quality testing strategy for CDMO autoclave qualification

blocks.zh: 在 aseptic fill-finish CDMO，高壓滅菌器通常用於滅菌：
blocks.en: In an aseptic fill-finish CDMO, autoclaves are typically used to sterilize:

blocks.zh: 灌裝用玻璃瓶（vials）、瓶塞（stoppers）
blocks.en: Glass vials and stoppers for filling

blocks.zh: 製程設備（配液桶、濾器殼體）
blocks.en: Process equipment (compounding vessels, filter housings)

blocks.zh: 滅菌袋（autoclave bags）和耗材
blocks.en: Autoclave bags and consumables

blocks.zh: 建議確認策略：
blocks.en: Recommended qualification strategy:

blocks.zh: 在 OQ 階段進行所有三項蒸汽品質測試（NCG、乾燥度、過熱度）
blocks.en: Perform all three steam quality tests (NCG, dryness, superheat) at the OQ stage

blocks.zh: 在 PQ 初始取樣階段重複三項測試
blocks.en: Repeat the three tests during the initial sampling phase of PQ

blocks.zh: 年度定期重新測試（至少每年一次）
blocks.en: Periodic annual retesting (at least once a year)

blocks.zh: 每次 PSG 維護後立即重新測試
blocks.en: Retest immediately after every PSG maintenance activity

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3.3
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 3.3

blocks.zh: 您的高壓滅菌器使用 121°C 飽和蒸汽（約 1 barG）。根據 ISPE 提供的公式，您是否需要進行過熱度計算測試？請說明理由。
blocks.en: Your autoclave uses 121°C saturated steam (about 1 barG). Based on the formula provided by ISPE, do you need to carry out the superheat calculation test? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 在 Bowie-Dick 測試失敗後，您懷疑是 NCG 超標。請設計一個調查流程，從蒸汽系統的角度找出根本原因。
blocks.en: After a failed Bowie-Dick test you suspect excessive NCG. Design an investigation flow to find the root cause from the steam system perspective.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 NCG 和乾燥度的取樣閥可以共用一個位置，但化學品質（導電度、TOC）的取樣點必須不同？從取樣原理角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why can the NCG and dryness sampling valves share one location, while the sampling points for chemical quality (conductivity, TOC) must be different? Explain from the sampling principle.

blocks.zh: 乾燥度測試的 Pitot 管取樣方法取的是管路中心的蒸汽。這個方法在什麼情況下最可能低估實際的液態水含量？
blocks.en: The Pitot tube sampling method for the dryness test takes steam from the center of the pipe. Under what conditions is this method most likely to underestimate the actual liquid water content?

blocks.zh: Sampling Plans (Frequency and Duration) / 取樣計畫（頻率與期間）
blocks.en: Sampling Plans (Frequency and Duration)

blocks.zh: Qualification phases, routine monitoring, and shutdown re-qualification | 確認階段、例行監控與停機後重新確認
blocks.en: Qualification phases, routine monitoring, and shutdown re-qualification

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 取樣計畫設計思維
blocks.en: Commentary — Design Thinking Behind the Sampling Plan

blocks.zh: 取樣計畫的四個狀態維度
blocks.en: Four system-state dimensions of the sampling plan

blocks.zh: ISPE 將純蒸汽系統的取樣需求依「系統狀態」分類，而不是簡單地給一個固定頻率。這反映了現代 GMP 的風險基礎思維（risk-based approach）：
blocks.en: ISPE classifies the sampling needs of a pure steam system by "system state" rather than simply giving one fixed frequency. This reflects the risk-based approach of modern GMP:

blocks.zh: 停機復原後：風險最高，需要最密集的取樣
blocks.en: Recovery after shutdown: highest risk, requires the most intensive sampling

blocks.zh: 維護後：系統完整性可能受到干擾
blocks.en: After maintenance: system integrity may have been disturbed

blocks.zh: 驗證期間：遵循三階段 PQ 計畫
blocks.en: During validation: follows the three-phase PQ plan

blocks.zh: 例行操作：依據確認結果設定的週期性監控
blocks.en: Routine operation: periodic monitoring at a frequency set on the basis of the qualification results

blocks.zh: 風險分析在取樣計畫設計中的應用
blocks.en: Applying risk analysis in sampling plan design

blocks.zh: 不同 POU 的風險等級可能不同。靠近產品直接接觸點（如灌裝機上方的過濾器滅菌用高壓滅菌器）的 POU，風險等級高於非接觸用途的 POU。取樣頻率應反映這個差異。
blocks.en: Different POUs may carry different risk levels. A POU close to a direct product contact point (for example, an autoclave used for filter sterilization above a filling machine) carries a higher risk than a POU for non-contact use. Sampling frequency should reflect this difference.

blocks.zh: 3.4.1 Commissioning and Qualification (C&Q) / 試車與確認
blocks.en: 3.4.1 Commissioning and Qualification (C&Q)

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — C&Q 概念
blocks.en: Commentary — The C&Q Concept

blocks.zh: Commissioning vs. Qualification 的本質差異
blocks.en: The essential difference between commissioning and qualification

blocks.zh: 試車（Commissioning）是工程行為：確認設備按設計規格運行。這是 GEP（Good Engineering Practice），不受 QA 正式監管，但數據可用於支持後續確認。
blocks.en: Commissioning is an engineering activity: confirming that equipment operates to its design specifications. It is Good Engineering Practice (GEP), is not formally overseen by QA, but its data can be used to support later qualification.

blocks.zh: 確認（Qualification）是法規要求行為：在 QA 監管下，提供文件化證據，證明系統持續一致地提供符合規格的純蒸汽。
blocks.en: Qualification is a regulatory activity: under QA oversight, it provides documented evidence that the system consistently delivers pure steam that meets specification.

blocks.zh: ISPE 建議善用試車數據——如果試車計畫足夠嚴謹且接受標準經 QA 批准，試車數據可以用來支持 PQ 取樣計畫設計，甚至縮短正式 PQ 時間。
blocks.en: ISPE recommends making good use of commissioning data: if the commissioning plan is sufficiently rigorous and the acceptance criteria have been approved by QA, commissioning data can be used to support the design of the PQ sampling plan and may even shorten the formal PQ.

blocks.zh: 3.4.2 Commissioning Sampling & Qualification (PQ) / 試車取樣與效能確認
blocks.en: 3.4.2 Commissioning Sampling & Qualification (PQ)

blocks.zh: 中文深度解說 — 三階段 PQ 策略
blocks.en: In-Depth Commentary — The Three-Phase PQ Strategy

blocks.zh: 「最壞情況位置」的選擇標準
blocks.en: Criteria for selecting "worst-case locations"

blocks.zh: 初始取樣要求在「最壞情況位置（worst-case locations）」取樣，這通常是：
blocks.en: Initial sampling must be performed at "worst-case locations," which are usually:

blocks.zh: 距離 PSG 最遠的 POU：蒸汽品質可能因長途傳輸而降低
blocks.en: The POU farthest from the PSG: steam quality may degrade over a long run of piping

blocks.zh: 系統最低點：最容易積聚冷凝水，乾燥度最差
blocks.en: The lowest point of the system: most likely to accumulate condensate, with the worst dryness

blocks.zh: 最長支管末端：對於有多個分支的系統
blocks.en: The end of the longest branch: for systems with multiple branches

blocks.zh: 這個設計思維與生物安全檢測的「最差情況挑戰（worst-case challenge）」概念相同——如果在最壞的位置都合格，其他位置更有把握。
blocks.en: This design thinking is the same as the "worst-case challenge" concept in biological safety testing: if the worst location passes, there is greater confidence in all the others.

blocks.zh: 比喻：三階段 PQ 就像新員工試用期
blocks.en: Analogy: the three-phase PQ is like a new employee's probation period

blocks.zh:
Initial：到職第一個月，密切觀察能否達到職位要求。
Intermediary：第二個月，確認表現的一致性，可以開始承擔部分正式工作。
Extended：完整的一年試用，各種季節性變化（冬夏溫差、設備保養）都經歷過，才能正式認定是可靠的員工。
blocks.en:
Initial: the first month on the job, closely observing whether the person can meet the requirements of the role.
Intermediary: the second month, confirming consistency of performance; the person can begin to take on part of the formal workload.
Extended: a full year of probation, going through all seasonal changes (summer and winter temperature swings, equipment maintenance), before the person is formally recognized as reliable.

blocks.zh: CDMO 新客戶專案啟動的 PQ 時間規劃
blocks.en: PQ timeline planning when starting a new CDMO client project

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 承接新客戶的第一批商業生產，純蒸汽系統的 PQ 時間線應該納入專案計畫的關鍵路徑：
blocks.en: For a CDMO taking on the first commercial batch for a new client, the PQ timeline of the pure steam system should be included on the critical path of the project plan:

blocks.zh: Initial + Intermediary：至少 6-20 個工作天（視系統規模）
blocks.en: Initial + Intermediary: at least 6-20 working days (depending on system size)

blocks.zh: Extended：剩餘至滿 1 年
blocks.en: Extended: the remainder until a full 1 year is reached

blocks.zh: 第一批商業生產最早在 Intermediary 階段 QM 批准後才能生產
blocks.en: The first commercial batch can be produced at the earliest after QM approval at the Intermediary phase

blocks.zh: 這意味著系統啟動到第一批正式商業生產，至少需要 2-4 週的 PQ 緩衝時間。在項目計畫中忽略這個時間要求是常見的 CDMO 項目延誤原因。
blocks.en: This means that from system start-up to the first formal commercial batch, a PQ buffer of at least 2-4 weeks is needed. Overlooking this time requirement in the project plan is a common cause of CDMO project delays.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3.4.2
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 3.4.2

blocks.zh: 您的純蒸汽系統有一個 PSG、3 個主要 POU（高壓滅菌器 A、B、C）和兩條支管，各支管末端各有一個排放閥。請繪製初始取樣計畫，列出所有必須取樣的位置和每日頻率。
blocks.en: Your pure steam system has one PSG, three main POUs (autoclaves A, B and C) and two branch lines, each with a drain valve at its end. Draw up the initial sampling plan, listing all locations that must be sampled and the daily frequency.

blocks.zh: 初始取樣階段第 2 天，PSG 出口的導電度超出規格（OOS）。根據 ISPE 的要求，您應採取什麼行動？這個 OOS 是否中斷初始取樣計畫？
blocks.en: On day 2 of the initial sampling phase, the conductivity at the PSG outlet is out of specification (OOS). According to ISPE requirements, what action should you take? Does this OOS interrupt the initial sampling plan?

blocks.zh: 試車數據是否可以直接替代 PQ Initial 階段的數據？需要滿足哪些條件？
blocks.en: Can commissioning data directly replace the data from the PQ Initial phase? What conditions must be met?

blocks.zh: 在延伸取樣階段，PSG 每週取樣一次，各 POU 輪流每兩週取樣一次。請設計一個 12 週的輪流取樣排程，確保每個 POU 至少被取樣 6 次。
blocks.en: In the extended sampling phase, the PSG is sampled once a week and the POUs are sampled in rotation, each once every two weeks. Design a 12-week rotating sampling schedule that ensures each POU is sampled at least 6 times.

blocks.zh: 3.4.3 Ongoing Routine Monitoring Program / 例行持續監控計畫
blocks.en: 3.4.3 Ongoing Routine Monitoring Program

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 例行監控計畫
blocks.en: Commentary — The Routine Monitoring Program

blocks.zh: 化學/生物屬性 vs. 物理屬性的不同監控頻率
blocks.en: Different monitoring frequencies for chemical/biological and physical attributes

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出，蒸汽品質的物理屬性（NCG、乾燥度、過熱度）和化學/生物屬性（導電度、TOC、內毒素）可以採用不同頻率。
blocks.en: ISPE states explicitly that the physical attributes of steam quality (NCG, dryness, superheat) and the chemical/biological attributes (conductivity, TOC, endotoxin) may be monitored at different frequencies.

blocks.zh: 這是因為：
blocks.en: This is because:

blocks.zh: 化學/生物屬性：主要受進水質量影響，每週或每月取樣可及時發現趨勢
blocks.en: Chemical/biological attributes: mainly affected by feed water quality; weekly or monthly sampling can detect trends in good time

blocks.zh: 物理屬性：主要由系統設計決定，在系統穩定後變化緩慢；但維護後或季節性溫度變化可能影響
blocks.en: Physical attributes: mainly determined by system design and change slowly once the system is stable; however, they may be affected after maintenance or by seasonal temperature changes

blocks.zh: 範例表 3.5 中，蒸汽品質（NCG/過熱/乾燥）只需每年在高壓滅菌器使用點測試，但化學品質每週就要在 PSG 出口測試。
blocks.en: In the example Table 3.5, steam quality (NCG/superheat/dryness) only needs to be tested once a year at the autoclave point of use, whereas chemical quality is tested weekly at the PSG outlet.

blocks.zh: Alert Level vs. Action Level 的趨勢管理
blocks.en: Trend management: Alert Level vs. Action Level

blocks.zh: 例行監控數據必須建立趨勢分析（trending）機制：
blocks.en: Routine monitoring data must feed a trending mechanism:

blocks.zh: Alert Level（警示限）：超出表示系統開始偏離，需要調查，但不必立即停止生產
blocks.en: Alert Level: an excursion indicates that the system is starting to drift and needs investigation, but production does not have to stop immediately

blocks.zh: Action Level（行動限）：超出表示系統可能失控，必須立即採取 CAPA 措施
blocks.en: Action Level: an excursion indicates that the system may be out of control and CAPA must be taken immediately

blocks.zh: 如果趨勢顯示系統在「控制狀態（state of control）」，可以考慮降低取樣頻率（通過變更控制執行）。反之，若出現不良趨勢，必須增加取樣頻率。
blocks.en: If trends show that the system is in a "state of control," a reduction of sampling frequency can be considered (implemented through change control). Conversely, if an adverse trend appears, sampling frequency must be increased.

blocks.zh: 為什麼不需要測試微生物總數（TAC）？
blocks.en: Why is testing for total aerobic count (TAC) not required?

blocks.zh: 蒸汽本身具有致死特性（lethal properties）——121°C 以上的飽和蒸汽能殺死所有微生物。因此，測試純蒸汽冷凝水的微生物總數（total aerobic count）在科學上是不必要的：如果蒸汽達到規定溫度，就不可能有活菌存活。
blocks.en: Steam itself has lethal properties — saturated steam above 121°C kills all microorganisms. Testing pure steam condensate for total aerobic count is therefore scientifically unnecessary: if the steam reaches the specified temperature, no viable organisms can survive.

blocks.zh: 但要注意：冷凝水收集後如果不妥善處理，可能在容器中再次受到環境污染。取樣程序本身的無菌操作很重要。
blocks.en: Note, however, that if condensate is not handled properly after collection, it may be re-contaminated from the environment in the container. Aseptic technique in the sampling procedure itself is important.

blocks.zh: CDMO 多客戶共用純蒸汽系統的挑戰
blocks.en: The challenge of a pure steam system shared by multiple CDMO clients

blocks.zh: CDMO 環境中，同一純蒸汽系統可能同時服務多個客戶產品的製造。例行監控計畫設計必須考慮：
blocks.en: In a CDMO, the same pure steam system may serve the manufacture of several clients' products at the same time. The design of the routine monitoring program must take into account:

blocks.zh: 最嚴格的客戶要求決定整體監控頻率（以最嚴格者為準）
blocks.en: The most stringent client requirement determines the overall monitoring frequency (the strictest governs)

blocks.zh: 客戶審計（client audit）時必須能提供系統監控記錄
blocks.en: System monitoring records must be available during client audits

blocks.zh: 如果某客戶要求 EP 合規，則所有使用此系統的產品都必須符合 EP 要求（包括亞硝酸鹽/外觀測試）
blocks.en: If one client requires EP compliance, all products using this system must meet the EP requirements (including the nitrate/appearance tests)

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3.4.3
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 3.4.3

blocks.zh: 根據表 3.5 的例行監控計畫，一年內您總共需要收集多少個樣品（假設系統有 1 個 PSG 出口、2 個單程分配最遠端、4 個使用點，其中 2 個連接高壓滅菌器）？
blocks.en: Based on the routine monitoring plan in Table 3.5, how many samples in total do you need to collect in one year (assuming the system has 1 PSG outlet, 2 single-pass distribution far ends and 4 points of use, 2 of which are connected to autoclaves)?

blocks.zh: 連續 3 個月的週期取樣顯示 PSG 出口的導電度呈上升趨勢，但仍在規格內。這是否需要開立偏差報告（deviation report）？應採取哪些調查行動？
blocks.en: Weekly sampling over 3 consecutive months shows an upward trend in conductivity at the PSG outlet, but it is still within specification. Is a deviation report required? What investigation actions should be taken?

blocks.zh: 您的客戶（歐洲藥廠）在審計中要求看純蒸汽冷凝水的亞硝酸鹽（nitrates）測試記錄。您的現行取樣計畫中沒有這個項目。這是否是 GMP 缺失？如何補救？
blocks.en: Your client (a European pharmaceutical company) asks during an audit to see pure steam condensate nitrate test records. This item is not in your current sampling plan. Is this a GMP gap? How would you remediate it?

blocks.zh: 夏天（外部氣溫 38°C）時，純蒸汽的乾燥度測試是否比冬天（10°C）更可能不合格？從管路散熱的角度分析。
blocks.en: In summer (outside temperature 38°C), is the pure steam dryness test more likely to fail than in winter (10°C)? Analyze from the perspective of heat loss from the piping.

blocks.zh: 3.4.4 System Shutdown / 系統停機後的取樣要求
blocks.en: 3.4.4 System Shutdown

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 停機後復原策略
blocks.en: Commentary — Recovery Strategy After Shutdown

blocks.zh: 停機後重新確認的觸發條件
blocks.en: Triggers for re-qualification after shutdown

blocks.zh: SOP 中應明確定義「長時間停機」的定義（例如：超過 72 小時或超過 7 天）。停機期間，管路中的殘留冷凝水可能積聚微生物，進水系統可能引入新的污染源。
blocks.en: The SOP should clearly define what counts as a "prolonged shutdown" (for example, more than 72 hours or more than 7 days). During a shutdown, residual condensate in the piping may accumulate microorganisms, and the feed water system may introduce new sources of contamination.

blocks.zh: 停機後最低要求：在恢復生產前，必須對 PSG 出口和所有使用點進行化學品質（導電度、TOC）和生物品質（內毒素）測試，並在結果符合規格後才能放行生產。
blocks.en: Minimum requirements after shutdown: before production resumes, chemical quality (conductivity, TOC) and biological quality (endotoxin) must be tested at the PSG outlet and at all points of use, and production may be released only after the results meet specification.

blocks.zh: CDMO 建議：計畫性停機（如年度保養）應在保養完成後安排 PSG 再確認運行（re-qualification run），包括蒸汽品質測試（NCG/乾燥/過熱），以確認保養工作未影響系統性能。
blocks.en: CDMO recommendation: for planned shutdowns (such as annual maintenance), arrange a PSG re-qualification run after maintenance is complete, including steam quality tests (NCG/dryness/superheat), to confirm that the maintenance work has not affected system performance.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3.4.4
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 3.4.4

blocks.zh: 農曆新年期間工廠停機 10 天，純蒸汽系統完全關機。復工前應執行哪些步驟，才能讓系統重新投入生產？請列出具體的行動清單（action list），包括誰負責執行和記錄。
blocks.en: The plant shuts down for 10 days over Lunar New Year, and the pure steam system is completely switched off. What steps should be carried out before restart so that the system can return to production? Provide a specific action list, including who is responsible for performing and recording each step.

blocks.zh: 停機後的化學品質測試結果顯示導電度符合規格，但內毒素輕微超標（0.28 EU/ml，規格 <0.25 EU/ml）。請說明 OOS 調查流程和可能的根本原因。
blocks.en: After a shutdown, chemical quality results show conductivity within specification, but endotoxin is slightly out of specification (0.28 EU/ml against a specification of <0.25 EU/ml). Describe the OOS investigation process and possible root causes.

blocks.zh: 您的 SOP 定義「長時間停機」為超過 72 小時。如果工廠週五下午關機，週一早上開機，是否需要進行停機後完整取樣？這個 SOP 定義是否合理？
blocks.en: Your SOP defines "prolonged shutdown" as more than 72 hours. If the plant shuts down on Friday afternoon and restarts on Monday morning, is full post-shutdown sampling required? Is this SOP definition reasonable?

blocks.zh: Chapter 3 Part 1 — Summary & Key Takeaways / 總結與核心要點
blocks.en: Chapter 3 Part 1 — Summary & Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: Integration of steam quality, sampling locations, and qualification strategy | 蒸汽品質、取樣位置與確認策略整合
blocks.en: Integration of steam quality, sampling locations, and qualification strategy

blocks.zh: 核心學習要點（中文）
blocks.en: Key Learning Points (Commentary)

blocks.zh:
純蒸汽品質直接決定滅菌循環的效能
NCG 是蒸汽穿透測試失敗最常見的原因
—— 控制進水 NCG，是確保高壓滅菌器合規的第一道防線
blocks.en:
Pure steam quality directly determines the efficacy of the sterilization cycle
NCG is the most common cause of failed steam penetration tests
— Controlling NCG in the feed water is the first line of defense for autoclave compliance

blocks.zh: CDMO Operations Director 視角：最高優先事項
blocks.en: CDMO Operations Director perspective: top priorities

blocks.zh: 確保所有使用純蒸汽的高壓滅菌器都有完整的三階段 PQ 文件
blocks.en: Ensure that every autoclave using pure steam has complete three-phase PQ documentation

blocks.zh: 建立 PSG 維護後強制性蒸汽品質重新測試的 SOP
blocks.en: Establish an SOP making steam quality retesting mandatory after PSG maintenance

blocks.zh: 年度內部稽核應包含純蒸汽取樣計畫執行的合規性查核
blocks.en: Include a compliance check of pure steam sampling plan execution in the annual internal audit

blocks.zh: 新客戶引進時，確認是否有額外的蒸汽品質要求（如 HTM 2031 for NHS）
blocks.en: When onboarding a new client, confirm whether there are additional steam quality requirements (such as HTM 2031 for the NHS)

blocks.zh: 趨勢數據定期審查，設定適當的 Alert/Action Level
blocks.en: Review trend data regularly and set appropriate Alert/Action Levels
